The Expected-to-move entry for post-merge-menu/f1 is not observable here because Before already satisfies f1 verbatim, so the After wording delivers the template migration (Verdict line, 'Pick one:', 'Not offered: approve' on the step-6 menu, 'show evidence prints the full record' hint) without regressing anything.
